poster.alt: Tajweed Circle — every Tuesday after Isha, free to attend at Ghousia Masjid. Learn to read the Qur’an with Tajweed and rectify your Salah recitation. Suitable for reverts and complete beginners. Non-judgmental environment; all welcome 16+; support WhatsApp group; native English teacher with 13 years of experience.
Dars-e-Quran — every Thursday at 7:45pm at Ghousia Masjid, with Hazrat Allamah Pir Syed Shamsul Arifeen Shah Sahib.
